evaluatorPublisherBoundary: Existing runtime repair publication runs in the evaluator, which remains stopped until the exact candidate host configuration and Compose selector are verified. Existing retained handoffs are terminal and their bytes stay bound.
intakeBoundary: Normal core and worker intake is paused while those services are stopped and may resume after SDK starts the candidates. Fresh checks before later stages observe new work; if a check fails, retain the running installation for inspection without stopping new work. No blanket durable intake closure is claimed.
scope: One approved launch using the existing SDK and closed argv, two exact image replacements and the same evaluator with one scoped source-root/config change plus atomic Compose selection.
unknownDispatchBoundary: No automatic retries or recovery. A later, known recovery action needs separate exact authorization and evidence.
